text_block_list.text:
Today, I depart for France alongside 
Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's as far as I can accompany you, 
*desu*! You two can handle the rest 
together, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I have plenty of charms already. 
...Jordan, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...! Hang in there...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Why are you already hitting the climax 
before we even leave? Good grief... you 
really are something.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Festa. Please have a match you 
won't regret."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I really wish I could have gone to 
watch it together with you, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...That is more than enough, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Watch me until the very end. Witness my 
race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Otherwise, you won't be 
able to win your bet either, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Festa!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Mom? What's going on, running in like 
that...?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I cut it so close! Here, your 
lunchbox!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text:
If you get hungry while waiting for the 
plane, eat together with Trainer! Don't 
cause too much trouble for your Trainer, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...

Seeing Nakayama Festa completely dazed, I 
accept the paper bag from her mother 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text:
No, I look forward to working with you as 
well! And also...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mother
text_block_list.text: Make sure not to get hurt, Festa.

Seen off by everyone, I passed through 
security and waited in the airport lounge.
choice_data_list: …Boarding time is almost here, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list:
Want to eat the boxed lunch your mother 
made?

Want to eat the boxed lunch your mother 
made?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can eat all this in such 
a short time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll savor it slowly once I'm on board.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ………… ...Back in the day, you know...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I think my family had their hands full 
with me. Their daughter suddenly turned 
into quite the spitfire, after all.
choice_data_list: Back when I was a little troublemaker?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was the eldest daughter, after 
all. It must've been bewildering for my 
mother to deal with her first child's 
rebellious phase.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Before that, we were just an ordinary 
family. Only thing was my mom occasionally 
grumbling about my dad not bringing home 
enough cash.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, suddenly I had to go bow my head 
at her school, and come home to a daughter 
I didn't know how to handle, day in and 
day out.”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, she didn't say a word when I 
said I was joining the racing class.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
They always made sure to pay my tuition, 
too. They even got all the money together 
for the academy's admission fee—
choice_data_list:
You've been cheering for them all this 
time, haven't you?

You've been cheering for them all this 
time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The people around me are all just 
ridiculously softhearted fools, really.
choice_data_list:
Let's turn everyone's feelings into power 
and go for the win.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there's nothing else to do but go.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —To seize the best possible result.
